content:
Maya: Thanks for the thoughtful questions in the town hall. I'm posting a concise timeline summary for API, Console, and Optimize and tagging owners for follow-ups.

Leah: API gen2 runtime: internal canary next Wednesday; partner canary ~3 weeks after that; GA aimed ~6 weeks post-partner canary. We'll expose `api_version=gen2` so customers can opt-in; pinned model versions remain on gen1 unless opted in.

Devon: Any expected client changes? We operate a few webhook consumers in-house.

Leah: Minimal client tweaks for streaming frames (better incremental func-arg payloads). We'll publish migration samples. Backwards compatibility maintained for 90 days after GA; extended support is available for enterprise customers.

Ravi: Dedicated/private ops question: will upgrades require node reboots or planned downtime windows?

Leah: Dedicated: control-plane first, then rolling node runtime updates; most upgrades non-disruptive but we'll share maintenance windows per deployment. Private (on-prem) customers get a packaged runtime delta and a checklist to run upgrades at their cadence.

Claire: Console features: per-route token cost, latency percentiles, and canary control UI. When's beta?

Leah: Console beta (internal + pilot partners): April 25. Public opt-in beta mid-May. GA end of Q2. Console will show live rollout states and allow easy rollbacks.

Maya: How does Optimize land relative to Console? We promised integration.

Leah: Optimize v1: batching/caching advisor -> internal alpha in ~2 sprints, public alpha by month-end. Quantization recommender with model-specific quality estimates targeted for Q3. Console will surface Optimize suggestions as one-click experiments during public alpha (expected late-May).

Devon: SDK coordination? Breaking changes?

Claire: Small SDK changes: `client.stream()` will emit an extra `partial_function_args` event. We'll open Python/JS PRs after the internal canary. Deprecation of old stream frames 90 days after GA; customers can purchase an extended compatibility window up to 6 months.

Deploy Bot: "canary: api/gen2 -> cluster-canary at 1987654300"

Maya: Action items: 1) @Leah publish timeline + migration checklist by EOD tomorrow. 2) @Claire open SDK PRs and post sample webhook migration code. 3) @Ravi draft Dedicated/Private maintenance notice templates and share with CS. 4) Product to publish beta invite process.

Leah: I'll post the doc to #eng and update the public roadmap entry.

Claire: I'll queue SDK PRs and add examples.

Ravi: Will coordinate with CS and Sales on maintenance/SLAs.

Maya: If anyone on the panel asked a question that's not covered here, paste it and we'll route to the right owner. Thanks :confetti_ball:
